display.purpose: Upright threshold statements at arrival and invitation only.

body.purpose: Navigation, project information, captions, and running copy.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase chapter and artwork metadata.

shadows.name: physical-only
shadows.purpose: DOM elements remain flat; shadow and depth come from the Three.js architecture.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Quiet UI entrances and modal settling.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Balanced state changes with no bounce or overshoot.

motion.name: scroll-damping
motion.purpose: Deterministic smoothing between normalized document scroll and camera progress.

components.name: Primary Call to Action
components.description: The single high-contrast commercial action used in the final salon.
components.css: .ds-cta-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-bone); color: var(--color-charcoal); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 220ms var(--ease-out), transform 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-cta-primary:hover { background: var(--color-warm-light); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cta-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Call to Action
components.description: A low-chrome text action for opening the accessible work archive.
components.css: .ds-cta-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-bone); font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: color 220ms var(--ease-out), transform 120ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-cta-secondary:hover { color: var(--color-warm-light); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-cta-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-cta-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Edge Navigation
components.description: N9 navigation with a serif wordmark and one hard-right destination.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; color: var(--color-bone); font-family: var(--font-body); } .ds-nav a { font: 400 20px/1 var(--font-display); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Artwork Label
components.description: A frameless museum caption revealed only near its associated work.
components.css: .ds-art-label { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--color-bone); } .ds-art-label span { font: 400 20px/1.1 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-art-label small { font: 500 11px/1.2 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: .13em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Chapter Rail
components.description: A slim informational rail that names the current architectural chapter.
components.css: .ds-chapter { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 112px auto; justify-items: end; gap: 12px; color: var(--color-bone); font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-body); letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chapter i { display: block; width: 1px; height: 100%; background: var(--color-bone); } .ds-chapter span:last-child { writing-mode: vertical-rl; }

narrative.overview: The website behaves like a private architectural exhibition after hours: spatially quiet, materially warm, and composed through alternating compression and release. The interface recedes so limestone openings, controlled pools of light, and physically mounted photography carry the narrative. The system rejects conventional web-section rhythm. Its durable language is monolithic geometry, edge-aligned editorial type, architectural occlusion, and camera movement that always resolves into a stable view.
keyCharacteristics: restrained warm-mineral palette with darkness that retains material detail;
full-viewport photographic compositions with small museum-like annotations;
one continuous spatial route with real corners, thresholds, and ceiling changes;
weighted motion with no bounce, wobble, particles, or novelty rotation.

rules.name: The Photography Rule
rules.body: Interface accents stay below five percent of the viewport. The work, not UI color, is the chromatic event.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Upright serif speaks only at key emotional thresholds; restrained grotesk handles every navigational or informational role.

rules.name: The Still-Frame Rule
rules.body: Every major scroll position must remain visually intentional when motion stops.

dos: Do use walls, openings, corners, and light spill as transition devices.
Do let future rooms remain partially concealed.
Do use real three-dimensional parallax and occlusion where possible.
Do keep motion damped, deterministic, and resolute.
Do keep all stock imagery replaceable through one manifest.
donts: Don't use video, carousel, grid-portfolio, or SaaS-section conventions.
Don't use neon, chrome-heavy reflections, glassmorphism, particles, lens-flare spectacle, or glowing orbs.
Don't spin, bounce, wobble, or perpetually float artwork.
Don't illuminate the whole building evenly.
Don't let the canvas become the only accessible source of project information.
